# Mir Yoke — local project-harness platform

## Required default consumer payload
- `starter/README.md` — preservation-first adoption guide
- `starter/HARNESS.md` — canonical repository contract template
- `starter/CLAUDE.md` — Claude entrypoint
- `starter/AGENTS.md` — generated Codex entrypoint

The starter is documentation-only. It does not require a Mir CLI, installer, plugin, hook, memory
database, spec tree, sub-agent, daemon, receipt, or platform-specific runtime.

## Optional capability packs
- `safety` — stable repository-bound deterministic checks
- `memory` — preview local SQLite/FTS context
- `collaboration` — preview runtime-neutral roles and executor guidance
- `assurance` — preview specification and verification evidence

Profiles are advisory. Use `yoke plan` before `yoke apply`; conflicts are never overwritten.

## Maintainer checks
- `uv run pytest tests/test_minimal_starter.py -q`
- `uv run pytest tests/test_product_planes.py tests/test_distribution_builder.py tests/test_yoke_composer.py -q`
- `uv run python scripts/verify_codex_sync.py`
- `uv run ruff check`

Existing bootstrap, memory, plugin, hook, executor, and spec implementations are preserved as
optional pack source and maintainer regression material.
